title: Uwatoranijwe mu buryo burambuye
intro: Mu gicucu cy'umusozi aho amagambo y'Imana yamanukiye, ukwizera kw'abantu kwarahungabanye munsi y'izahabu irabagirana. Umuntu umwe, ufite impano yo kuvuga, yahagaze nk'inkunga ku butumwa bukomeye, ariko ahura n'ikigeragezo gikomeye. Ubwo intumwa yatoranijwe yazamukaga mu muhango wera, uyu muntu yasigaye inyuma, asaba ishyanga rituje. Ni nde uyu muntu ushikamye ufite ijwi ryazamutse rirwanya ibishushanyo mbonera?
clues: Natowe na Allah ngo mbe umuhanuzi, nubwo inkuru yanjye ikunze kuvugwa hamwe n'indi.
Noherejwe ku mutegetsi w’umunyagitugu, ariko inshingano yanjye yari iyo gushyigikira, ntabwo ari iyo kuyobora.
Nari mfite impano yo kuvuga neza, kandi amagambo yanjye yari agamije koroshya imitima.
Ubwo mugenzi wanjye yajyaga mu nama yera, nasigaye nyobora abantu batagira aho bahurira.
Kubera kwihangana kwabo, bakoze ishusho mu mitako yabo, kandi ndabasaba gukomeza kuba indahemuka kuri Allah.
Mugenzi wanjye yaragarutse aramfata, ariko namusobanuriye ko abantu bantsinze kandi hafi yo kunyica; ntabwo nari mu bakoraga ibibi.
arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
